title: Cookie Hunger Bar
description: Makes the hunger bar COOKIES! Appleskin compatible.
body:
Cookie Hunger Bar!

Makes the hunger bar into cookies (if that wasnt obvious)

Vanilla-like, I think.

![Cookies...](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b983d010b45a8c0f1a2d97aaa35d2df15956290f.png)

Custom textures for [Appleskin](https://modrinth.com/mod/appleskin) too!

Newly added support for [Farmer's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight-refabricated) effects!

Cookies are good. yes.
Who wouldn't want cookies for a hunger bar?
